Session diagnosis also root-caused the residual winter/shoulder overshoot (see the 2026-07-10 calibration-log entry): ~half was the C3a/C3b scoring-basis wedge (fixed by rubric v2.4, parallel session), the rest decomposes into one fake-scarcity winter morning (Jan-5-2023, +4.1 of Jan's +7.1 $/MWh equal-hour gap) and a +9-14 $/MWh surplus-hour floor overshoot present all 12 months (act<$15 hours; winter-dominant by hour count).
